headline.size_rel: n/a - no headline card, only captions

caption.size_rel: ~6-7% of frame height, 2-3 words per line, 2 lines max

layout.host_pos: selfie/vlog full-bleed, host walks and talks holding phone at arm's length; later cuts to laptop-screen recording
layout.safe_zones: captions sit lower-third, avoid absolute bottom (~10-15% from bottom) and top status bar
layout.caption_pos: lower-third, centered, pink/magenta rounded-rect pill background behind white bold text

transitions: walking handheld selfie pans into location
screen-record laptop footage cut in mid-scene
cutaway to a talking-head reference clip (borrowed/inset) around t=17-19s and t=34-36s
